Home / Fees

Fees and policies

Individual therapy is $240 for a 50-minute online session, self-pay. Trail walk and movement therapy is $240 to $370 depending on session length. LPC supervision is $425 a month. EMDR consultation is $185 an hour. Blue Cross Blue Shield is accepted; other clients are self-pay, and major credit cards are the accepted form of payment.

Cancellation

For telehealth appointments, cancel at least 24 hours ahead or you may be charged an $85 fee for the session.

In-person walk therapy must be paid in advance to hold the spot, and there are no refunds for cancellations inside 48 hours.

Where you have to be

A Texas license covers clients located in Texas, so both you and your therapist must be physically in the state during a telehealth session. Tell your therapist in advance if you will be traveling and the appointment can be moved rather than canceled.

Waitlist and new clients

Clients who want to be added to the waitlist schedule a consult first. The practice's associates are accepting new clients, including at sliding-scale fees.

Trail walk and equine work requires a consult plus one to three online sessions beforehand, and is for adults only.

Texas notices

Licensing and complaints

Reem Glasco holds Texas LPC license number 66562. To file a complaint about a Texas licensee, contact the Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council at 1-800-821-3205 or enforcement@bhec.texas.gov to request the appropriate form. Mailed complaints go to:

Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council
Attn: Enforcement Division
George H. W. Bush State Office Building
1801 Congress Ave, Ste 7.300
Austin, TX 78701

The Executive Council investigates and prosecutes professional misconduct by marriage and family therapists, professional counselors, psychologists, psychological associates, social workers and licensed specialists in school psychology. Not every complaint or dispute involves professional misconduct, and the Council will explain how to file either way. License verification is available at bhec.texas.gov.

Access to your records

Under the Texas Medical Records Privacy Act (HB 4224, effective 1 September 2025) you have the right to access your health care records and to file complaints. Submit a written request to info@findingbalancecounselingpllc.com. Records are provided electronically within 15 business days unless you agree to another format or an exception applies.

Complaints about this practice

To raise a concern directly, email info@findingbalancecounselingpllc.com. To file a consumer complaint with the state, forms and instructions are on the licensing authority's website and, where applicable, the Texas Attorney General's site.
